summary.text: Troy Charbonneau is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 53, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a paramedic with Laurel EMS who previously spent more than 20 years with the Yellowstone County Sheriff's Office.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Troy Charbonneau said he has more than 25 years of service to Yellowstone County through law enforcement, EMS and community service, and that he has lived in the county his entire life.

He said he spent more than 20 years with the Yellowstone County Sheriff's Office as a patrol deputy, detective, school resource officer and crimes against children investigator, including assignments at Canyon Creek, Elder Grove and Broadview Schools.
He said he now works as a paramedic with Laurel EMS.

Charbonneau described his priorities as lowering property taxes, supporting law enforcement and first responders, protecting constitutional rights, strengthening rural health care and EMS services, and keeping government transparent and accountable.
